frozen_pass_rule: PASS only if every one of 3 fresh registered replicates has companded rollout MSE / raw-state persistence MSE < 1.0 on all 15 splits (45/45 cells). Any single cell >= 1.0 makes Phase 17 FAIL. No retry or replacement of a consumed replicate.
